grade_rationale: 12 P1s (exceeds C max of 2), 72 P2s (exceeds C max of 15), 0% domain spec coverage (fails C minimum of 40%). Auth bypass (proxy-addr) + RCE (protobufjs) conditions met in infrastructure layer.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer does not check Specifications/ — 79 domain FRs unverified
findings.detail: tools/traceability-enforcer.py only scans Plans/<feature>/requirements.md. The 79 canonical domain FRs in Specifications/ have 0% source coverage. The enforcer reports PASS despite total domain-layer blindness.
findings.failure_scenario: Developer omits or misimplements a domain FR; enforcer gate passes silently because it only checks Plan-level IDs.
findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan Specifications/*.md for FR-[0-9]+ IDs and cross-check against source Verifies: comments. Or establish explicit FR-NNN → FR-WF-NNN mapping.

findings.title: Three route handlers directly call store, bypassing the service layer
findings.detail: workItems.ts, intake.ts, and workflow.ts all import and call workItemStore functions directly. CLAUDE.md rule: No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.
findings.failure_scenario: Business logic added to a future workItemService.ts (validation, audit hooks) silently does not apply to these routes — routes bypass the service layer entirely.
findings.recommendation: Create services/workItemService.ts and services/intakeService.ts. Route handlers must only call service functions.

findings.title: vitest RCE — arbitrary file read/execution via UI server (CVSS 9.8)
findings.detail: When vitest UI server is listening, an attacker with network access can read arbitrary files (including .env secrets) and execute arbitrary JavaScript.
findings.failure_scenario: Dev server exposed on network: attacker reads .env, extracts credentials, achieves code execution in dev environment.
findings.recommendation: npm install vitest@5.1.1 across all affected projects. Never expose vitest UI server on a public network.
findings.escalate_reason: sensitive data exposed, RCE via dev tooling

findings.title: protobufjs RCE — arbitrary code execution via deserialization (CVSS 9.8)
findings.detail: Malformed protobuf messages trigger arbitrary code execution during deserialization in the gRPC layer.
findings.failure_scenario: Attacker sends crafted protobuf to gRPC endpoint → code execution on orchestrator host.

findings.title: proxy-addr IP spoofing — IPv4-mapped IPv6 bypasses authentication ACLs (CVSS 9.1)
findings.detail: IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses are incorrectly normalized, allowing an attacker to forge trusted IPs and bypass IP-based authentication ACLs in Express.
findings.failure_scenario: Attacker crafts IPv4-mapped IPv6 request (e.g., ::ffff:127.0.0.1) → bypasses IP allowlist → gains unauthorized access.
findings.escalate_reason: auth bypass — explicit config escalation trigger

findings.title: 9 additional critical CVEs across portal/Backend (4), Source/Backend (2), portal/Frontend (2), Source/Frontend (cascade)
findings.detail: Remaining critical CVEs beyond DEP-001/002/003: vitest cascade in portal packages (4 critical in portal/Backend), jest ecosystem cascade in Source/Backend (2), and additional portal/Frontend criticals (2).
findings.recommendation: Phase 1 fix: npm audit fix --force in portal/Backend, Source/Backend, portal/Frontend after vitest/jest upgrades. See dependency-audit-2026-11-18.md for full package list.

findings.title: List route passes raw store object to res.json — fragile API contract
findings.detail: GET /api/work-items passes store.findAll() result directly to res.json(). Any store shape change silently changes the API contract with no compile-time error.
findings.failure_scenario: Store refactors return shape; API consumers break silently at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Map store response to explicit PaginatedResponse<WorkItem> type in the route handler.

findings.title: eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 production files
findings.detail: Suppressing exhaustive-deps hides potential stale-closure bugs in React hooks. These suppressions are in recently modified files.
findings.failure_scenario: Dependency added to hook callback but not to deps array; hook runs with stale data silently.
findings.recommendation: Fix the underlying deps array issue. If suppression is intentional, add inline comment explaining why.

findings.title: 70 high-severity CVEs across npm projects (jest cascade, browserslist OOM, ws DoS, body-parser, grpc-js)
findings.detail: Top packages: jest ecosystem (40+ high in Source/Backend), browserslist unbounded memory OOM, ws memory exhaustion DoS, body-parser compression bypass, grpc-js auth bypass. Full list in dependency-audit-2026-11-18.md.
findings.recommendation: Phase 2 (2 weeks): npm install jest@30.5.2+, browserslist@4.28.7+, ws@8.21.0+, body-parser@1.20.9+, grpc-js@1.11.3+
